38ee69e0.text: Despite his harsh upbringing, young Thrall grew into a strong, quick-witted $r, and he knew in his heart that a slave's life was not for him. As he grew to maturity, he learned about his people, the orcs, whom he had never met: after their defeat, most of them had been placed in internment camps. Rumor had it that Doomhammer, the $r leader, had escaped from Lordaeron and gone into hiding. Only one rogue clan still operated in secret, trying to evade the watchful eyes of the Alliance.
38ee69e0.title: The New Horde

48e845c9.text: The chief warden of the internment camps, Aedelas Blackmoore, watched over the captive orcs from his prison-stronghold, Durnholde. One $r in particular had always held his interest: the orphaned infant he had found nearly eighteen years before. Blackmoore had raised the young male as a favored slave and named him Thrall. Blackmoore taught the $r about tactics, philosophy, and combat. Thrall was even trained as a gladiator. All the while, the corrupt warden sought to mold the $r into a weapon.
48e845c9.title: The New Horde

7b006821.text: The resourceful yet inexperienced Thrall decided to escape from Blackmoore's fortress and set off to find others of his kind. During his journeys Thrall visited the internment camps and found his once-mighty race to be strangely cowed and lethargic. Having not found the proud warriors he hoped to discover, Thrall set out to find the last undefeated $r chieftain, Grom Hellscream.
7b006821.title: The New Horde

10360|54d735c8.name: Kergul Bloodaxe
10360|54d735c8.text: $N, the Silverwing Sentinels must be crushed!  Are you ready for Warsong Gulch?

14942|5204716c.name: Kartra Bloodsnarl
14942|5204716c.text: Lok'tar $c!  We have need of your services in Alterac Valley.  Shall I add you to the lists?

15006|1f5c2160.name: Deze Snowbane
15006|1f5c2160.text: The humans and their so-called League of Arathor think to push us out of Arathi Basin.  I think not $c!  Are you ready to be sent there and demonstrate that it is they, and not The Defilers, that will be leaving soon?

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

248196|dd3ed090.name: Apothecary Durelle
248196|dd3ed090.text:
Please do not touch the vials unless you intend to purchase one.

Fingerprints ruin the value, you see.

248197|cc5aee35.name: Gor'mak
248197|cc5aee35.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

263647|53fff4bc.name: Borook Gallfist
263647|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3408|f1c86baa.name: Zel'mak
3408|f1c86baa.text: Take it easy, mon. I only train da warriors.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

3890|e664c9fd.name: Brakgul Deathbringer
3890|e664c9fd.text: Throm'ka $c!  Are you ready to fight for the Horde at Warsong Gulch?

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7427|090f8855.name: Taim Ragetotem
7427|090f8855.text: Our forces in Alterac Valley need wisdom to achieve victory $c.  You look like the one to lead them.

1060-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
1060-accept.text:
You've done so well for me, $N. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
1060-accept.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

845-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-complete.text:
Not bad, $N.  Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs.  A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!

It looks like you have some strength in you too.  Are you ready for a real challenge?
845-complete.title: The Zhevra

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

853-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
853-accept.text:
I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.

She is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.

Do hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
853-accept.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-complete.text:
Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering.  He garnered your aid in delivering them?  Good.

And the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery.  Well done, $c.
853-complete.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

865-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
865-complete.title: Raptor Horns

865-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-progress.text: Did you get the horns, $N?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!
865-progress.title: Raptor Horns

872-complete.name: Thork
872-complete.text:
Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.

Your people should be proud to count you among them.
872-complete.title: The Disruption Ends

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

875-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-complete.text: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
875-complete.title: Harpy Lieutenants

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-accept.text:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
876-accept.title: Serena Bloodfeather

876-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-complete.text: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
876-complete.title: Serena Bloodfeather

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

877-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-complete.text:
Your findings are amazing!  The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead.  Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!

We must study this more...
877-complete.title: The Stagnant Oasis

880-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-accept.text:
Your findings are incredible, $N.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
880-accept.title: Altered Beings

887-complete.name: Gazlowe
887-complete.text:
You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
887-complete.title: Southsea Freebooters

888-accept.name: Gazlowe
888-accept.text:
While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
888-accept.title: Stolen Booty

890-accept.name: Gazlowe
890-accept.text:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

890-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-complete.text:
Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
890-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-complete.text:
Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.

Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
891-complete.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
892-accept.text:
Everything looks square from my records, $N. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
892-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

892-complete.name: Gazlowe
892-complete.text:
No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

Looks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?
892-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

903-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-accept.text:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, $N, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
903-accept.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces
